contributions.detail: THE DeBRY BASIS INVERSION, CONFIRMED AT THE PAGE. Schedule A prints SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE = $4,500.00, which equals Summary Column A (the PERIOD figure), while TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages) = $57,703.50, which equals Summary Column B (the CYCLE-CUMULATIVE figure). The two printed anchors on the same sheet have DIFFERENT SCOPES. The 2 transcribed rows sum to 4,500.00 = the page subtotal = Summary line 1 Column A, so the side is EXACT. Gating on schedule-grand-total would have manufactured a $53,203.50 delta out of an exact filing.

expenditures.detail: Same inversion on Schedule B: SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE $36.36 = Summary Column A; TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE $19,975.92 = Summary Column B (cycle-cumulative). The single transcribed row is 36.36 = the page subtotal = Summary line 2 Column A. EXACT.
